company.name: NEAR Intents
company.one_liner: The universal trading protocol for onchain markets and tokenized assets.
company.description: NEAR Intents is the universal trading protocol powering one-click cross-chain swaps and unified liquidity for onchain markets and tokenized assets. Using a novel intent-based transaction infrastructure that empowers users to express outcomes instead of managing routes, bridges, and liquidity sources, NEAR Intents unlocks frictionless cross-chain swaps for DeFi users, autonomous trading for AI agents, and broad distribution for blockchains, dApps, and asset issuers.
company.boilerplate: NEAR Intents is the universal trading protocol powering one-click cross-chain swaps and unified liquidity for onchain markets and tokenized assets. Using a novel intent-based transaction infrastructure that empowers users to express outcomes instead of managing routes, bridges, and liquidity sources, NEAR Intents unlocks frictionless cross-chain swaps for DeFi users, autonomous trading for AI agents, and broad distribution for blockchains, dApps, and asset issuers. NEAR Intents has powered billions of dollars in volume across leading chains and assets and is now natively integrated into major DeFi protocols, wallet providers, traditional financial systems, and AI platforms, bringing instant and verifiable execution to global markets.
target_audience: AI agents requiring autonomous trading capabilities
value_propositions: Outcome-Driven: Users define what they want, not how to get it
Cross Chain by Default: Native multi-chain support without bridges
Secure and Permissionless: Trustless execution with competitive solving

black.name: Black
black.usage: Primary backgrounds, high contrast text, dominant brand element

off_white.name: Off White
off_white.usage: Light backgrounds, text on dark, clean interface areas

orange.name: Orange
orange.usage: Primary accent, CTAs, emphasis, energy moments

yellow.name: Yellow
yellow.usage: Accent highlights, gradient endpoint, warm emphasis

gradients.name: Primary Gradient
gradients.usage: Hero accents, emphasis moments, call-to-action highlights

colors.palette_mood: Bold and technical. The black-orange contrast creates energy and urgency appropriate for financial technology. The warm orange-yellow gradient adds dynamism while maintaining a professional, trustworthy foundation. The monochromatic grey scale provides flexibility for complex UI without visual noise.

data.family: FK Grotesk Mono or JetBrains Mono
data.usage: Transaction hashes, addresses, code snippets, technical data

typography.style_notes: FK Grotesk is a geometric sans-serif that balances technical precision with approachability. Its clean lines work well for both marketing headlines and dense technical documentation. The typeface supports the brand's positioning as an advanced protocol that remains accessible to users.

visual_style.overall_aesthetic: Technical minimalism with energetic accents. Clean, confident presentation that communicates reliability and innovation in blockchain infrastructure.
design_principles: Clarity through hierarchy - information architecture over decoration
Controlled expression - bold moments balanced with neutral spaces
Consistent identity - unified visual language across all touchpoints
Technical credibility - precise, intentional design choices

imagery.photography: Minimal use, abstract tech visualizations when needed
imagery.motion: Smooth transitions, purposeful animations that demonstrate cross-chain flows

iconography.chain_icons: Use official chain logos (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, etc.)

shapes.cards: Rounded corners, subtle borders or shadows

cards.style: Dark background (#272727 or #000000), subtle border, 12px radius
variants: Feature cards with icon + title + description
Chain support cards with chain icon

badges.chain_badges: Pill shape, chain color or neutral grey

brand_voice.language_style: Clear, precise technical communication that respects user intelligence. Explains complex concepts without condescension. Uses active voice and concrete examples.

writing_guidelines.headlines: Clear value proposition, active voice, 3-8 words
writing_guidelines.body_copy: Explain the what and why, use examples

extraction_metadata.confidence_notes: Official brand color palette provided with exact hex values, PMS codes, and CMYK values. Color hierarchy and approved pairings explicitly documented. Typography specified as FK Grotesk. Product messaging and boilerplate provided directly. Website content confirms brand positioning and voice.

crypto_native_indicators: Cross-chain swaps (BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, XRP, ZEC)
web3_signals.positioning: Infrastructure layer - B2B protocol for DeFi applications, wallets, and AI agents rather than direct consumer product
anti_patterns: Avoid comparison to traditional DEX aggregators
